dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tea possesses an essence that cannot be changed.

dialogues.speaker: Hitomi
dialogues.text: Well, you're right. No matter how the ceremonies change, the feelings of the people who drink tea are always the same.

dialogues.speaker: Hitomi
dialogues.text: These are what you mean by "the things that never change," yes?

dialogues.speaker: Hitomi
dialogues.text: Ah, who knew tea encompassed such vast knowledge! I've learned so much!
